phase_a_discovery.pool_universe: SOL-paired, non-blacklisted, TVL>=50000 USD, 24h volume>=25000 USD
phase_a_discovery.unreadable_transaction_policy: Advance to the next finalized signature in recency order without consulting PnL. A pool is incomplete unless 24 readable transaction bodies are obtained within the first 40 eligible finalized signatures.

behavior_dimensions: repeated add/remove activity as rebalance proxy

repeatability_rule.rebalance_behavior: descriptive; consensus reported but not required to establish repeatability

exact_parameter_derivation.hold_seconds: median of per-wallet median hold seconds among wallets supporting the consensus holding-duration bucket
exact_parameter_derivation.width_bins: rounded median of per-wallet median width bins among wallets supporting the consensus range-width bucket

candidate_strategy_rule: Do not use the ten legacy 60-second observations to fit the new candidate.

Do not freeze a candidate until at least three frozen-cohort wallets satisfy the preregistered profitable-wallet definition and at least two-thirds of profitable wallets independently share both the same dominant holding-duration bucket and the same dominant range-width bucket.

If repeatability is proven, derive one candidate only: future on-chain LP add by any frozen profitable wallet is the entry signal; use the same preregistered SOL-paired pool universe; place the paper range symmetrically around the current active bin; set exact width and hold time by the preregistered cross-wallet median formulas.
Freeze exactly one candidate in a later reviewed commit before any prospective test.
Prospective test data must be strictly post-freeze.
No threshold may be lowered merely to manufacture trades.

amendment_history.reason: Provider-only acquisition repair after pre-PnL discovery run 35403624464 failed on a finalized getTransaction read.
Preregister a mechanical cross-wallet repeatability and exact candidate-parameter derivation rule before any frozen-cohort PnL analysis.
